# Industry portraits

## Classification by industry adaptation characteristics

| Industry | Demand Matches | Reason | Relevant scenes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Manufactured/equipment/fouling | High | Multi-SKU, multi-silo, procurement, production, after-sale and off-standard processes | Procurement - stock - after sale; CRM - refunds |
| Renewable resources/energy | High | Price fluctuations, cost accounting, retroactive and compliance | Procurement, costs, traceability, operating boards |
| Cross-border trade/textile | High | Cross-regional, order, procurement, production and delivery synergies | Orders - procurement - production - delivery; multilingual meetings |
| Medical equipment | High | Overriding, after-sale, equipment maintenance and compliance | CRM, WMS, EMS, VP. |
| Finance/China | Medium High | High value of security, auditing and privatization | Privatization conferences, contracts, knowledge questions and answers |
| Retail/American trade chain | Medium | There are many vendors, members and stockpiles in demand, but there are many mature competitions. | Store, purchase, board. |
| A simple Internet team. | Low | More generic collaboration and documentation and more mature collaboration platforms | Common collaboration and knowledge management |
